title: Grateful Dead Live at Music Hall on 1971-04-07
source: Source: sbd > master reel > pcm > dolby A decoded dat > pcm (Sony beta HG) - recorded by Betty Cantor and provided by Tim Dalton; Transfer: pcm > Sony SL-10 > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 > wav 16/44.1 - transferred by Charlie Miller; Lineage: wav > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16; edited and mastered SIRMick February 2018

ai_review.summary: Good recording of a strong show, though the standout post‑drum jam is unfortunately cut short.
ai_review.review: The two reviewers rate this tape highly, praising its overall energy and calling it “dynamite.” The only notable drawback is that the much‑lauded jam after the drum solo is truncated, which some listeners find disappointing. No specific comments about soundboard or audience source are given, but the lack of complaints suggests a listenable recording.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave high marks (5 and 4 stars) indicating a good musical performance; the only issue is an edited jam, while no recording problems are mentioned, leading to an overall solid rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit comments on sound clarity or mix; absence of complaints implies the audio is acceptable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show is described as energetic with a notable drum‑jam segment, but that highlight is cut short, affecting overall flow.

band_member_comments.Drums: Jam after drums highlighted as a high point, though the edit truncates it.
